subject: Cross-functional calibration: delegation rules and anonymized matrix review
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Cross-functional calibration: delegation rules and anonymized matrix review

Hi all —

I want to lock a 90-minute slot for a cross-functional calibration workshop to finalize ratings alignment for Eng Platform and Product Analytics. Goal is to:

- Surface cross-team comparisons where managers diverge by 2+ bands.
- Agree delegation rules for reviewers when managers are recused or out of scope.
- Validate the anonymized calibration matrix and confirm appeals/exception path.

Draft agenda attached (agenda-draft.md). Please review the anonymization approach I outlined in the doc and add comments by EOD Tuesday. Key asks:

1) Confirm whether the proposed reviewer delegation ladder (peer-review -> director backup -> cross-functional reviewer) is acceptable for your org.
2) Flag any employees who should be excluded from cross-team comparisons for confidentiality/legal reasons.
3) Confirm the appeals panel membership (HR + one director + one peer).

Proposed times: Wednesday 12/16 10:00–11:30 PT or Thursday 12/17 2:00–3:30 PT. I’ll send calendar once we have a preferred time.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-functional calibration: delegation rules and anonymized matrix review

Thanks Vanessa — good plan. Quick notes:

- I like the delegation ladder but suggest adding a constraint that cross-functional reviewers cannot be from the same reporting chain to avoid bias.
- For bandwidth reasons, if a director steps in as backup, they should be provided the manager’s one-page calibration notes (not full packet).
- I drafted a quick reviewer roster template and a first cut at the anonymized matrix (stubbed) — attaching 'anon-calibration-matrix.xlsx' (anonymized IDs + normalized scores + variance flags).

Attachment: anon-calibration-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

A couple of process asks:
- Can we avoid sending raw manager narratives in the initial pass to cross-functional reviewers? Use summaries only.
- Suggest the appeals window be 5 business days after the final distribution.

Prefer Wednesday 12/16 10:00–11:30 PT.

—Karthik
Senior Engineering Manager
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-12T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-functional calibration: delegation rules and anonymized matrix review

Vanessa / team —

Couple of points from Product side:

- We need explicit handling for any employee currently in an active performance improvement plan (PIP) or with open HR investigations — those should be excluded from cross-team ranking until resolved.
- The anonymized matrix looks reasonable, but can we ensure that the combination of role/level+variance flags doesn't allow easy deanonymization (small teams). For example, a single L6 on a team with 2 ICs is easy to spot.

On appeals: I agree with a 5-business-day window, but we should add an initial 'triage' step where HR confirms whether the appeal is about process (allowed) versus a factual evidence request (handled differently). That reduces noisy appeals.

I can share a short checklist for exclusion criteria if helpful. Otherwise, Wednesday works for me.

—Lauren
Group Product Manager
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-functional calibration: delegation rules and anonymized matrix review

Thanks everyone — HR notes below: 

- Exclusions: active PIP or open investigation => exclude from cross-team comparisons until case closed. If the manager believes there is a compelling reason to include, they must document it and get EVP HR sign-off.
- Anonymization: we recommend removing team size metadata and replacing level with 'level bucket' (e.g., L4-5, L6-7) to reduce deanonymization risk. Also, shuffle row order before distribution.
- Appeals process: 5 business days is fine. Triage flow: HR intake -> process/facts split -> factual evidence routed to manager for review -> process issues escalated to the calibration panel. I'll draft the intake form and attach it to Confluence.

Related link: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/HR/Calibration+Process+2026 (policy + intake form)

I’ll prepare the intake template and a short checklist of exclusion criteria by EOD tomorrow so you can attach it to the workshop packet.

—Marissa
Senior People Partner, Talent & Org
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cross-functional calibration: delegation rules and anonymized matrix review

Appreciate the input and quick turnaround. Final decisions for the workshop: 

- Time: Wednesday 12/16 10:00–11:30 PT (calendar invite sent).
- Delegation ladder: peer-review -> director backup (must be outside reporting chain) -> cross-functional reviewer pool. Directors stepping in will get manager one-pagers only.
- Anonymization: implement Marissa's recommendations (level buckets + remove team-size metadata + shuffle rows). Karthik, will you replace the current sheet with the revised anonymized matrix?
- Appeals: 5 business days, HR triage first. Marissa: please attach the intake form and exclusion checklist to the Confluence page and upload the final packet to the shared Drive before the workshop.

Attachments: anon-calibration-matrix.xlsx (final anonymized matrix)
Related link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xCalibAgenda/edit (final agenda + in-line notes)

If anyone sees a blocker between now and Wednesday morning, flag it here. Otherwise, I’ll run the session and we’ll capture exception notes in the workshop minutes.

Thanks — Vanessa
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
